messages:
Maya (Docs): FYI i'm starting a targeted sweep to harmonize rate + quota examples across the docs site. scope: header examples, meter names, and two dashboard links that customers reported as 404s. i'll open a small PR later today.

Ethan (Platform): thanks. can you call out any changes that touch telemetry names? we need to keep the ingestion stable.

Maya (Docs): yes — i'll replace `tokens.generated` instances with the canonical `tokens.rendered` and add a short note in the migration section. not changing any backend metric ids.

Rosa (PM): please preserve the pricing math text. only update code blocks and dashboard URLs. product legal approved the wording last month.

Maya (Docs): understood. code-only updates except for an extra sentence mentioning "billing attribution" behavior for burst credits.

Noah (Eng): small heads up — the SDK v1 header still shows up on two quickstart pages. if you switch them to the v2 header, confirm the auth header example uses `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY` (old examples used `X-Api-Key`).

Maya (Docs): good catch. i'll standardize to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY` everywhere.

Clara (Support): one of our customers opened a ticket because meter names in their dashboard panel didn't match docs. can you add a tiny mapping table (old -> new) in the migration guide?

Maya (Docs): yes — mapping table will be added to the migration note. also adding an inline example showing how to update Grafana panels (panel json snippet).

Ethan (Platform): if you include a panel JSON, keep it minimal and do not expose internal org ids. i can review the snippet for safety.

Maya (Docs): will scrub IDs. sample panel will only show `metric: tokens.rendered` and a `sum()` aggregation.

DevBot: PR checklist reminder: run lint, build, linkcheck.

Maya (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 (WIP). included: 6 files changed, mapping table, two dashboard link fixes, and unified SDK header snippets.

Noah (Eng): i'll run the examples locally against staging to confirm no regressions. if i find runtime mismatches i'll comment on the PR.

Rosa (PM): thank you. timeline?

Maya (Docs): aiming to land by tomorrow afternoon, barring issues. ping me for reviews.

Ethan (Platform): i'll skim the PR today and flag any telemetry concerns.

Clara (Support): once merged, can docs trigger a short announcement so support can update the affected KB article?

Maya (Docs): yep — i'll post a short note in #support and attach the migration snippet.

DevBot: CI started for pr/4987 — linkcheck in progress.
